About this item

  • 【COMFORTABLE MATERIAL】 The women's shorts sleeve tops from Dokotoo are made with a soft and breathable fabric that keeps the skin feeling comfortable, even in sweaty situations. Whether for work, sports, or other activities, these Round neck t-shirts will keep you dry and comfortable all day.
  • 【ESSENTIAL BASIC】 The deep design of these t-shirts is both and flattering, ensuring that you can avoid any wardrobe malfunctions. These t-shirts are a timeless and essential piece in any wardrobe, adding a touch of sexiness to your outfit.
  • 【FLATTERING FIT】 The women's fitted shirts are designed with good elasticity to accommodate different body sizes. They come in a variety of colors and sizes, allowing you to have a different and new option every day. These tops for women will fit beautifully and flatteringly.
  • Match: This simple basic t-shirt can be paired perfectly with jeans, shorts, leggings, pants, or skirts for a concise and fashionable look. It can also be layered under a jacket in winter for added versatility
  • Extra large loose design style base tops. If you don’t like the big one, it is recommended to buy a smaller size to try on it.. Size: S=US 4-6,M=US 8-10,L=US 12-14,XL=US 16-18. Check more info of this tops in Size Chart and Product Description. Please choose carefully according to your size.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

Customers find the crop top to be of nice quality with an oversized fit that hangs well on the body, and they appreciate its super soft material, with one noting it's slightly heavier than basic tees. While some customers find the length great, others wish it was longer in the front, and opinions about the fabric thickness are mixed - some find it nice and thicker, while others say it's too thick for summer wear.

    5 out of 5 stars
    By far one of my most worn shirts since purchasing!
    Reviewed in the United States on March 22, 2025
    Size: X-LargeColor: Meadow Mist Green
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This shirt is so incredibly comfortable. My style is being as comfy as possible while still being socially acceptable. This exceeds socially acceptable, I get compliments on it every time it’s worn!

    It did not stretch or shrink when washed and the color is just as perfect as the day I got it! It’s definitely not the softest shirt I’ve ever worn, but it’s still a very comfortable, soft t-shirt material. It’s a thicker fabric than I was expecting - in a good way! - yet is not heavy or too warm.

    The wide neck allows you to pick between a little shoulder action or just having it central on your shoulders, but I will say, the shirt does tend to fall to one shoulder if you’re moving around a lot. The length of the shirt is perfect for me - I have a pretty short torso but a fuller chest which usually means anything cropped ends up way too short for my comfort. Because it’s meant to be oversized, you can easily adjust the way it sits as far as how cropped you want it, but again, I will say it doesn’t always stay where you place it.

    I already have this shirt in two colors and will be purchasing more on my next clothing haul!

About this Item

  • 【COMFORTABLE MATERIAL】 The women's shorts sleeve tops from Dokotoo are made with a soft and breathable fabric that keeps the skin feeling comfortable, even in sweaty situations. Whether for work, sports, or other activities, these Round neck t-shirts will keep you dry and comfortable all day.
  • 【ESSENTIAL BASIC】 The deep design of these t-shirts is both and flattering, ensuring that you can avoid any wardrobe malfunctions. These t-shirts are a timeless and essential piece in any wardrobe, adding a touch of sexiness to your outfit.
  • 【FLATTERING FIT】 The women's fitted shirts are designed with good elasticity to accommodate different body sizes. They come in a variety of colors and sizes, allowing you to have a different and new option every day. These tops for women will fit beautifully and flatteringly.
  • Match: This simple basic t-shirt can be paired perfectly with jeans, shorts, leggings, pants, or skirts for a concise and fashionable look. It can also be layered under a jacket in winter for added versatility
  • Extra large loose design style base tops. If you don’t like the big one, it is recommended to buy a smaller size to try on it.. Size: S=US 4-6,M=US 8-10,L=US 12-14,XL=US 16-18. Check more info of this tops in Size Chart and Product Description. Please choose carefully according to your size.
